page.overview:
Who is Ikru?

Ikru was voted by fellow delegates as the Earth Kingdom's first choice to represent them at the Four Nations Summit & Technological Symposium in Hari Bulkan, being highly charismatic and a great inventor. He grew annoyed with Minister Khuchtei of the Fire Nation, and believed that she was there to push the Fire Nation's agenda, regardless of whether the science agreed with her. To him, pushing national interests into the sciences was a crime against academics.

Ikru was housed at Tako Dormitory with the other delegates when he arrived in Hari Bulkan. He kept a pile of notebooks in his room that mostly contained ten to twenty seemingly random pages filled with stream of consciousness notes, though in fact contained hidden messages. He often took meals in the cafeteria on the first floor, avoiding Minister Khuchtei and offering games of Pai Sho and tea to everyone else. When crates of rare and precious meteorite metal were stolen, Ikru came to be regarded as a potential suspect.

Ikru was a short and handsome man with mesmerizing eyes.

Ikru was a very charismatic man, and was said to have a "silver tongue that could sell ice to the Water Tribes". He exuded friendliness and always seemed genuine.
